canada.summary: Crews are on the scene of a fire that ripped through a home under construction in North York early Friday morning.

canada.title: Dad whose 11-month-old died alleges Surrey Memorial Hospital staff mishandled case
canada.summary: Salahaddin Abrar died on April 19 while awaiting a liver transplant, days after the infant's family says a Surrey Memorial Hospital physician sent him home.

canada.title: Too many people posting 'gotcha' clips from surveillance cameras online, Sask. mayor says
canada.summary: Warman's mayor knew doorbell cameras were getting more popular. He didn't expect to see the videos in his inbox. "I started getting a few emails with people sending me videos of cars going in front of their house … or a cat going across their lawn."

canada.title: Crown stays murder charge against only accused in Sask. triple homicide
canada.summary: The Crown has dropped the murder charge against a woman who said she shot a man before he had the chance to shoot her at the scene of a triple homicide near Turtleford, Sask.

canada.title: Rotting trees, permit delays make firewood harvesting harder near Haines Junction
canada.summary: Woodcutters near Haines Junction say rotting beetle-killed spruce, permit delays and rising operating costs are making it harder to supply firewood. Despite strong demand, local operators say accessing usable timber remains a challenge.

canada.title: The military uses a Manitoba park for survival training. Some are worried about the wildfire risk
canada.summary: Much of the park burned in a wildfire last year, putting nearby residents and conservation advocates on edge about the military’s activities

canada.title: Shell drives spike in oil exploration bids off the coast of Newfoundland
canada.summary: Shell is leading a surge in oil exploration interest off the east coast of Newfoundland and Labrador, after several years of stagnation.

canada.title: Online gambling more than doubles among young Montreal men, study finds
canada.summary: A new study finds online gambling has more than doubled among young Montreal men, as treatment providers report more young people seeking help.

canada.title: Southwestern Manitoba doctor warns of rabies risk as potential bat exposures spike
canada.summary: A spike in reported potential exposures has doctors in Manitoba's Prairie Mountain Health region warning of the dangers of human contact with bats, including the risk of contracting rabies.

canada.title: Online doctors in Winnipeg to care for ER patients at Ste. Rose du Lac's hospital
canada.summary: A rural Manitoba hospital, struggling with a physician shortage, will soon start relying on doctors just over 200 kilometres away to help care for some of the patients in its emergency department.

canada.title: New Brunswick’s first data-centre town has thoughts to share
canada.summary: Long before data centre proposals in Lorneville and Miramichi were stirring opposition, and long before the province was grappling with how to regulate the sector, Gus Rioux was marching off to the Grand Falls town office, petition in hand.

canada.title: Victim hopeful as province plans to update law to prevent copper theft
canada.summary: The province is bringing changes to the Salvage Dealers Licensing Act to make it harder for thieves to sell stolen copper wire.

canada.title: Province opens $2.3-million program to support beef producers
canada.summary: Agriculture Minister Greg Morrow made the announcement outside Antigonish on Thursday. He anticipates many will apply to build or expand barns, but said the program also covers other infrastructure upgrades and cattle purchases.

canada.title: Mombourquette's leadership platform touts need for better collaboration
canada.summary: Given the province’s need for increased revenue, Nova Scotia Liberal Party leadership candidate Amanda Mombourquette says securing community buy-in for major development projects is a must.

canada.title: N.W.T. Indigenous leaders, business owner call for procurement policy with major projects on the way
canada.summary: As an Indigenous co-owner of a small business based in the N.W.T., Mildred Martin says she feels they have lost out on opportunities without a policy in place to help them compete with larger, more established non-Indigenous-owned firms from outside the territory.

canada.title: They thought they buried their brother in the family plot; it was a stranger instead
canada.summary: When two sisters from Springdale, N.L., made arrangements to bury their brother, they weren’t prepared for the ordeal ahead. Now, a year later, they’re hoping by sharing their story, it will lead to changes in how cremations are handled in the province.

canada.title: Worst of beef price hikes may be over, but don’t expect cheaper steak anytime soon
canada.summary: Beef prices are at record highs. But there is some good news for Canadians who enjoy a good steak. Beef prices have stabilized, but experts say that doesn't mean grocery prices will be dropping anytime soon.

canada.title: A mysterious U.S. army barrel washed ashore in Quebec. Why did it drum up anthrax concerns?
canada.summary: Quebec provincial police have confirmed that a barrel discovered on an uninhabited island in the St-Lawrence River does not contain active anthrax — ruling out the most dangerous possibility in an ongoing mystery.
